title: Clopen dimension loci in proper smooth connected families
statement: Let $S$ be Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $f:X\to S$ be proper and smooth [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and suppose its geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] are nonempty and connected [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], with dimension at most an integer $d\ge0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. For $0\le i\le d$ let $S_i$ be the set of points whose geometric fibre has dimension $i$. These sets are pairwise disjoint open and closed subsets covering $S$. With their open subscheme structures [def-weil-open-immersion], the base changes $f_i:X\times_S S_i\to S_i$ [def-pc-base-change] are proper and smooth with nonempty geometrically connected fibres of pure dimension $i$ [def-weil-pure-dimension]. The morphism $f_0$ is quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite].

proof.text: Apply the algebraic-closure connectedness criterion to each ordinary fibre. The isomorphism pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso identifies its base change with the geometric fibre in the hypothesis. GeometricallyConnected.iff_geometricallyConnected_fiber therefore makes f geometrically connected and surjective.

For a connected smooth scheme Y over a field, use regularity and the connected-regular-integral theorem to make Y integral. Choose a nonempty affine chart smooth of relative dimension n with Smooth.exists_smoothOfRelativeDimension_resLE; composition with the base open immersion adds zero to n. The chart has dimension n by topologicalKrullDim_eq_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension, and topologicalKrullDim_opens_eq identifies this with dim Y. The proved source smoothOfRelativeDimension_iff_topologicalKrullDim_eq gives SmoothOfRelativeDimension n on all of Y. This is the private helper connected_smooth_exists_relative_dimension; it introduces no deferred step.

Apply step 2 to each ordinary fibre. Its fixed relative dimension n survives extension to the algebraic closure; both nonempty schemes have dimension n. The source topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension also gives local dimension n at every ordinary fibre point. Thus D(f(x)) equals the local fibre dimension at x. Since the latter is locally constant and the proper surjective f is a quotient map, D is locally constant: a subset has open inverse image under D exactly when its inverse image under D composed with f is open.

Define U_i as the open level set D(s)=i for i in Fin(d+1). Local constancy makes it closed as well. Equality of dimensions forces equality of indices, hence disjointness. Each fibre has a natural-number dimension n from step 3, and the assumed bound gives n<=d, hence membership in U_n. This proves the supremum of these opens is top.

Base change to U_i preserves properness, smoothness and geometric connectedness, so every ordinary fibre is nonempty and geometrically connected. The already proved source topologicalKrullDim_fiber_of_isPullback identifies the ordinary dimension with the corresponding original ordinary fibre, since U_i is an open immersion and its residue-field map is an isomorphism. Step 3 identifies that dimension with D(s)=i. Applying step 2 again gives relative dimension i for each fibre. The source smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_fiberToSpecResidueField glues these to relative dimension i for the family. Its geometric fibres are connected smooth schemes of dimension i. They are integral by regularity and connectedness; their only irreducible component is the whole space, so they have pure dimension i.

For i=0 the restricted family is smooth of relative dimension zero, hence etale by Etale.iff_smoothOfRelativeDimension_zero. Etale morphisms are locally quasi-finite in Mathlib, so their fibres are locally Artinian and have discrete topology. Every singleton is open. Properness supplies locally finite type and quasi-compactness, completing precisely Scheme.Hom.IsQuasiFinite. No finite-closed-points argument is needed.
